items.summary: improve: reduce SQLite work during chat preparation (#168318) * perf(sqlite): checkpoint shared admission across workers (WIP) * test(sqlite): align worker fixtures with shared admission * perf(sqlite): avoid repeated quarantine reads in retained scopes * docs(sqlite): define single-owner database freshness * perf(sqlite): replace runtime probes with writer publications Checkpoint the single-owner cutover, cache invalidation regressions, and request-owned read transactions. Keep explicit migration verification. Paired measurement and final validation are still in progress. * test(sqlite): align first-admission coverage and deletion fixtures Route retained existing-state writer coverage through the host-owned worker project, preserve first-admission incompatibility refusal, and match the final deletion-authority contract. Keep the gateway test under its inherited line count by moving existing pure fixture helpers. Regenerate assertion allowances without adding production assertions. * build(sqlite): include shared admission in compiled wrappers Include the thirteen transitive admission modules required by the native wrapper import-closure proof. Carry the existing birthtime through the worker validation fixture to preserve its physical-file identity. * test(sqlite): use the canonical settlement owner in publication proof * fix(sqlite): complete writer custody and snapshot cache lifetimes Preserve snapshot-local reuse without freshness queries, publish dedicated archive writes, and remove Workboard polling. Retain native authority and settlement boundaries. Checkpoint reviewed corrections and focused regression repairs; final integrated proof remains in progress. * test(sqlite): exercise worker failure through its owner * fix(sqlite): retain integrity and worker admission through cleanup * fix(sqlite): preserve cleanup and explicit maintenance validation * fix(sqlite): retain revocation and scoped worker admission * test(sqlite): preserve reader coverage in existing fixture owners * fix(sqlite): preserve cache receipts across sibling writers and temp DDL * fix(sqlite): preserve migration and read-cache owners * fix(workboard): type the replacement card-list promise * fix(sqlite): preserve maintenance and bootstrap admission * fix(sqlite): keep temporary trigger admission connection-local * fix(sqlite): preserve unavailable discovery target isolation * perf(sqlite): coalesce memory and chat preparation commands * fix(sqlite): preserve cold schema admission in one-shot commands * refactor(sqlite): tighten one-shot result types and test boundaries * refactor(memory): make publication callback contracts explicit

items.title: perf(control-ui): seed reloads with authenticated config (#168265)
items.summary: perf(control-ui): seed reloads with authenticated config (#168265) Authenticated Control UI documents now carry the same bootstrap config as /control-ui-config.json (one builder, same read authorization, private no-store), so a signed-in reload paints the real brand and assistant identity before Gateway hello with no config request. Unauthenticated shells stay unchanged; plugin grant cookies are set only after the scope check.

items.title: 企業如何防止AI代理「做錯事」，專家建議四大治理方向
items.summary: 過去一年，「代理式AI」（Agentic AI）成了科技圈熱門關鍵字。從協助寫程式的自動化助手，到能自主處理郵件、管理檔案，甚至代為執行系統指令的智慧代理，這些工具正快速走進企業日常運作，成為員工桌面與伺服器環境中的新住戶。 當企業急著擁抱效率紅利，新的資安破口也隨之浮現。這些擁有自主行動能力的AI代理究竟握有多少權限？IT與資安部門是否知道員工的電腦裡裝了什麼？一旦AI代理判斷失準、代為執行了不該執行的動作，企業又該如何應對？
